body:
If you want to get SICK
I love Klonopin, I take it regularly for anxiety and I also use it relationally. I decided that since I had only one 0.5mg pill of klonopin and 50mg of Trazodone that I would smash them up and snort them. NOT a good idea. The klonopin was fine but the trazadone was very painful.
About 15 minutes in I felt a very nice loopy feeling but my nose hurt so badly, the pain was all I could concentrate on. I tried to just sleep it off but I woke up at 3 in the morning with horrible body aches and a killer headache. Not to mention I was blowing my nose about every 10 seconds.
In summary, klonopin is great, best orally in my opinion. And trazadone is also great for my insomnia but I will NEVER snort it again, only take as prescribed.
